description: Detection summary for a candidate long-range recombination-suppressed haplotype block. Captures the two complementary criteria used to retain a block as a candidate: long-range votes (do the same individuals repeatedly cluster together across the interval?) and local continuity (do adjacent windows agree on the grouping?). Cohort inherited from candidate.json.
